properties.title: SALAMANDER — Enterprise Product, Contract & API Lock

content: Locked identity: enterprise autonomic health, bounded recovery and operational governance control plane. The base enterprise product is independent of mining; SALAMANDER Mining is a separate workload integration. Status: responsibility baseline documented; adapter/version mapping and current acceptance open. Historical syntax pass, unrun pytest and unreported CI are not a production certification. ## Owned authority Ingest health/capability evidence; preserve unknown/unavailable states; quarantine unhealthy capabilities; apply circuit-breaker policy; stage bounded recovery DAGs; manage tenant admission/isolation, qualification refresh and rollback through registered authorised handlers. Learning cannot change correctness, conformance, storage integrity or safety policy. No arbitrary command, SQL, filesystem handler, dynamic execution or runtime source rewriting. No second proof, pool, execution-router, storage or policy root. ## API and integration contract | Surface | Documented source / required boundary | | --- | --- | | Typed autonomic control plane | Health envelopes, lifecycle, evidence, bounded actions and API snapshots in the historical integration record; exact callable/schema export not provided there | | Memory telemetry | phi_sdk.salamander_phi_telemetry.create_phi_telemetry_reporter and reporter generate_health_report() are documented integration examples, not current installed-package verification | | Telemetry packet | Statistics, derived score, severity, recommendation, governance flags and packet hash; freshness/authenticity policy must be explicit | | Compaction proposal | Telemetry-only adapter stages a proposal; no automatic mutation from a health score | | Approved action | Memory compaction requires the sovereign human approval described by that adapter; base recovery registration does not waive it | The historical memory document includes governor pseudocode/examples, not proof of deployed methods. SHA-256 packet hashing provides integrity, not sender authentication by itself. Example metric thresholds and latency estimates are not customer SLAs. ## Custody lineage condition Older SALAMANDER notes call OVID authoritative and THESEUS rebuildable; the newer triad gives Theseus durable custody and Ovid transformation. Keep both source histories. The enterprise target split is Ovid transforms / Theseus custody, but adapters must name actual component and version before binding storage authority. No destructive migration is authorised by this record. ## Non-mining acceptance requirement Inject stale/unknown enterprise service health, a quarantined capability and an unauthorised recovery request; confirm honest status, bounded authorised actions, no mutation from telemetry alone, restart truth reacquisition and auditable rollback. No fresh run is asserted. ## Customer schedule Define managed resources, authorised actions, approvals, tenancy, evidence retention and exclusions. No unbounded self-healing, guaranteed zero downtime or global failover claim. License, price, support, SLA and data-processing terms require approved schedules; historical Apache integration terms do not settle the complete product license. ## Source traceability - #108 SALAMANDER_AUTONOMIC_CONTROL_PLANE - SALAMANDER_INTEGRATION - feat(aethel): Chronus·Theseus·Ovid enterprise custody substrate - HYBA — Enterprise Product Lock Register
